ECI grants deadline to TMC faction on organizational polls and signatories

The Election Commission of India (ECI) has given a deadline of July 10 to a faction of the Trinamool Congress (TMC) led by Ritabrata. The faction is required to submit details regarding organizational elections and authorized signatories. This development pertains to an ongoing dispute within the party.
